item.title: Namima no Kuni no Faust
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: bitterdrop
  • 発売日: 2012-06-29
  • スコア: 7.19/10 (39 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 波間の国のファウスト
  • 英語名: Namima no Kuni no Faust

别名

  • Verweile doch! Du bist so schön.

あらすじ

The President of Chronos Investments, the company that stands at the very top of a world where money really does make it go round, also inherits a second title - that of ‘Hagetaka’, a vulture that picks mercilessly at rotting meat and still finds a use for it. It takes becoming a candidate in the exam that will determine the next Hagetaka to convince Yuuki Ritsuya to return to his homeland.
